content:
Successful HWPX template automation achieved through ZIP-based XML manipulation and regex-driven placeholder normalization.
The executor resolved placeholder fragmentation by using re.sub(r'</hp:t>\s*<hp:t>', '', xml_content) to merge split tags. Layout integrity was maintained by stripping <hp:lineSegArray> and <hp:lineSeg> tags to force viewer re-rendering. The process utilized the zipfile library to overwrite internal XML members, successfully applying custom formatting for '참석자수', '만족도', and '종합의견' fields.
